aircraft._commentFlaps: No aircraft-specific flap detents are configured: airbus-base intentionally does not assert shared Airbus flap notches. Add A321LR-specific detents only after vendor documentation or in-sim verification.

aircraftCfg._comment: The A21N designator is only accepted when both the title and creator identify the Microsoft/iniBuilds A321LR, preventing Fenix, LatinVFR, ceo, and non-LR A321 variants from matching.

lvars._comment: This profile uses documented standard SimVars only; no Microsoft/iniBuilds-specific telemetry routes are enabled.

controls._comment: The dedicated page is monitoring-only. Only Flight Fabric's narrow standard MSFS gear/flaps surface fallback is allowed; FCU, managed/selected-mode, autothrust, and other Airbus-specific writes remain unavailable until exact interactions and readbacks are verified in-sim.

meta.notes: Dedicated monitoring-first identity profile for the Microsoft / iniBuilds Airbus A321LR included with every Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 edition. Package matching uses identifiers documented by official Microsoft and iniBuilds sources. The page exposes only an explicit standard-SimVar read allowlist and no aircraft-specific writes because no vendor-published A321LR integration contract is available. Flap detents remain intentionally absent until A321LR-specific handle mapping is documented or verified in-sim.

sources.name: Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 FAQ - aircraft matrix
sources.notes: Lists the Airbus A321LR as an aircraft included with Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 Standard, Deluxe, Premium Deluxe, and Aviator editions.

sources.name: Microsoft Flight Simulator - Aircraft Manuals
sources.notes: Lists the Airbus A321LR manual as Version 1 from iniBuilds, supporting the canonical model and developer identity. The page does not publish an external telemetry/control variable map.

sources.name: iniBuilds Support - How to clear the WASM folder (A321LR)
sources.notes: Official iniBuilds support instructions identify the MSFS 2024 package as microsoft-aircraft-a321.

sources.name: MSFS 2024 Avionics Framework - SimVars
sources.notes: Documents standard MSFS SimVars/A-vars as queryable simulator state. The dedicated adapter uses an explicit read-only standard-SimVar allowlist and activates no aircraft-specific L: or B: variables.

sources.name: MSFS 2024 Avionics Framework - Key Events
sources.notes: Documents simulator key events. No A321LR-specific key-event mappings are activated; only Flight Fabric's narrow existing gear/flaps surface fallback remains allowed.

knownIssues: The exact SimConnect TITLE has not been verified in-sim; matching covers documented product-name and package-identity variants.
The cited sources do not define an A321LR LVAR, B-var, input-event, or hardware-integration map.
Standard simulator mirrors may be unavailable or differ from aircraft-internal managed/selected state and remain non-authoritative pending in-sim verification.
Flap detents are intentionally absent; do not inherit or reintroduce broad Airbus base detents without A321LR-specific evidence.
Aircraft-specific cockpit writes intentionally remain unavailable until exact controls and independent readbacks are verified.
